findings.interpretation: These are unadjusted descriptive extrema among non-overlapping 30-minute RTH blocks. They are inputs to Phase 6 preregistration, not candidate signals or evidence of tradability.

limitations: All results are exploratory, descriptive, and unadjusted for the many clock cells examined.
Overlapping forward horizons are correlated and must not be treated as independent tests.
One-minute OHLC bars do not reveal within-bar path or executable fill sequence.
The full-session and RTH clocks overlap because RTH is nested inside the Globex session.
Early-close sessions contribute only to clock cells whose entire horizon is observed.
No validation or final-test outcomes were inspected, and no strategy or tradable performance was produced.

method.interval_definition: Entry is the fixed clock bar open; exit is the final included bar close; MFE/MAE use the highs/lows of the included bars.

eth_full_session.definition: Entire contiguous CME Globex session from 18:00 to 17:00 Eastern.

rth.definition: Regular trading hours from 09:30 to 16:00 Eastern.
